hints.title: Sort and Deduplicate Replacement Values
hints.text: Sorting replacement candidates allows quick logarithmic lookup for the smallest valid substitute value greater than the preceding choice.

hints.title: Track Minimum Operations per Ending Value
hints.text: At each position, decide whether to keep the original element or substitute it with the smallest strictly larger available candidate.

hints.title: Dynamic State Compression
hints.text: Maintain a dictionary mapping each possible ending value to the minimum replacements needed up to the current index.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying every combination of keep or replace across N positions explores exponential branches.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Retaining only the minimum replacements for each distinct endpoint bounds active states at each stage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that only the smallest valid replacement value needs to be considered greedily.
complexity.notes: Sorting and deduplicating arr2 reduces binary search overhead.
